objective.primaryRule: No primary and no roles: nothing is searched for selection, ranked for a decision or selected (AD1). The study renews the GPU acceptance for the research-date-boundaries integration with a full checklist section 2 cycle, only if every gate passes (PROTOCOL.md section 6). The fixed-seed engineering mini-optimization is a parity device, never research evidence (AD2).

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: No search proposals for selection. backendEvaluations caps fresh CPU evaluations on real data (the CPU arms of the mini schedule, plain and with the envelope; the CPU references of the parity campaign, the finalists and the risk-delivery parity), as GPU Phase 7. GPU evaluations (sealed replays, the mini schedule, parity, reliability) are counted separately in the records; synthetic fixtures are not counted.

evaluationBackend.justification: Engineering acceptance study (GPU Phase 9): CPU evaluations are parity references (records and risk envelopes) and the non-official CPU arm of the mini schedule; GPU runs are non-official replays of sealed jobs, the mini schedule, parity and reliability tests. Nothing is official optimization evidence (standard 5.0.0 section 9.8); the engineering output, if every gate passes, is a new acceptance record (section 9.9) for the final integration code.

chronologicalConsequence: not applicable: a diagnostic with no search for selection and no chronological verdict (AD2)
